_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: The stored scope assessment per group and fiscal year (design D1, REQ-CBC-001); what the country-by-country file needs on group entities, returns and accounts, and the per-entity figures (design D2, REQ-CBC-002).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The Shillinq administration that keeps this entity's books. On the ultimate parent it names the parentAdministrationId of the group's ConsolidationGroup, through which the scope assessment reads the consolidated revenue.

tin.title: Tax identification number
tin.description: The entity's tax identification number in its country of residence. For a Dutch entity it defaults to the administration's RSIN. Use NOTIN when the entity has none, and say why in the TIN reason.

tinIssuedBy.title: TIN issued by
tinIssuedBy.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 code of the country that issued the tax identification number.

tinMissingReason.title: Reason for no TIN
tinMissingReason.description: Why the entity has no tax identification number, when TIN is NOTIN.

address.title: Address
address.description: The registered address, as the country-by-country file needs it.

incorporationCountry.title: Country of incorporation
incorporationCountry.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 code of the country the entity is incorporated in, when it differs from its tax residency.

bizActivities.title: Business activities
bizActivities.description: The entity's main business activities, as the OECD codes of the country-by-country report.

x-enum-labels.CBC507: Provision of services to unrelated parties
x-enum-labels.CBC511: Holding shares or other equity instruments

counterpartyRefs.title: Counterparty records
counterpartyRefs.description: The customer and payee records that stand for this entity in the other administrations of the group, so their ledger lines count as related-party revenue.

GroupScopeAssessment.title: Group scope assessment
GroupScopeAssessment.description: Whether a group is in scope for country-by-country reporting and for the minimum tax (Pillar Two) in one fiscal year, with the revenue each year it rests on and the filing deadlines it gives. Stored so the outcome relied on stays readable after the books change (REQ-CBC-001).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: A scope assessment decides which returns the group files; every change is kept for the tax director and the auditor.

ultimateParentEntity.title: Ultimate parent entity
ultimateParentEntity.description: The GroupEntityRegistry record of the group's ultimate parent.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year assessed, named by the calendar year it ends in.

fiscalYearStart.title: Fiscal year start
fiscalYearStart.description: The first day of the fiscal year.

fiscalYearEnd.title: Fiscal year end
fiscalYearEnd.description: The last day of the fiscal year.

revenueByYear.title: Revenue by year
revenueByYear.description: Consolidated revenue in EUR of the five years before the assessed year and of the year itself, each with where it came from.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Consolidated revenue in EUR; empty when not known.

cbcrInScope.title: Country-by-country report in scope
cbcrInScope.description: True when the consolidated revenue of the year before was EUR 750,000,000 or more.

pillar2InScope.title: Minimum tax in scope
pillar2InScope.description: True when the consolidated revenue was EUR 750,000,000 or more in at least two of the four years before.

firstCbcrYear.title: First country-by-country year
firstCbcrYear.description: The first fiscal year of the current run of years in scope for country-by-country reporting.

firstPillar2Year.title: First minimum tax year
firstPillar2Year.description: The first fiscal year of the current run of years in scope for the minimum tax.

cbcrFilingDeadline.title: Country-by-country filing deadline
cbcrFilingDeadline.description: 12 months after the end of the fiscal year; empty when not in scope.

girFilingDeadline.title: GloBE information return deadline
girFilingDeadline.description: 15 months after the end of the fiscal year, 18 in the first minimum tax year; empty when not in scope.

bijheffingReturnDeadline.title: Top-up tax return deadline
bijheffingReturnDeadline.description: 17 months after the end of the fiscal year, 20 in the first minimum tax year; empty when not in scope.

fxRates.title: Exchange rates
fxRates.description: The average and closing rate per currency for the year, used to convert the entity figures (design D2).

assessedBy.title: Assessed by
assessedBy.description: The user who pressed Assess scope, or system for the weekly job.

CbcrEntityFigures.title: Country-by-country entity figures
CbcrEntityFigures.description: The country-by-country figures of one group entity for one fiscal year, read from its books, entered or imported, kept per entity so they can be reviewed and corrected before they are summed per jurisdiction (REQ-CBC-002).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: The figures feed the country-by-country report; every change is kept for the tax director and the auditor.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: The GroupEntityRegistry record the figures belong to.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year, named by the calendar year it ends in.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code the amounts are in.

unrelatedPartyRevenue.title: Revenue from unrelated parties
unrelatedPartyRevenue.description: Revenue from parties outside the group.

relatedPartyRevenue.title: Revenue from related parties
relatedPartyRevenue.description: Revenue from other entities of the group.

profitBeforeTax.title: Profit before tax
profitBeforeTax.description: Profit or loss before income tax.

incomeTaxPaidCash.title: Income tax paid
incomeTaxPaidCash.description: Income tax paid in cash in the year.

tangibleAssetsOtherThanCash.title: Tangible assets other than cash
tangibleAssetsOtherThanCash.description: Net book value of tangible assets at year end, cash excluded.

deferredTaxExpense.title: Deferred tax expense
deferredTaxExpense.description: Deferred tax expense of the year, for the simplified effective tax rate.

eligiblePayroll.title: Eligible payroll costs
eligiblePayroll.description: Payroll costs of the year that count for the substance-based income exclusion.

numberOfEmployees.title: Number of employees
numberOfEmployees.description: Employees at year end, as full-time equivalents or headcount.

employeeMethod.title: Employee count method
employeeMethod.description: How the number of employees was found: from humaniq, or entered.

yearClosed.title: Year closed
yearClosed.description: False when the fiscal year was not closed when the figures were read, so accumulated earnings include the year's result.

unmappedAccounts.title: Unmapped accounts
unmappedAccounts.description: Account numbers with a movement or balance in the year and no country-by-country category.

topCounterparties.title: Largest counterparties
topCounterparties.description: The ten counterparties with the most revenue, so an intercompany customer missing from the counterparty records stands out.

related.title: Related
related.description: Whether the counterparty is a group entity.

computedAt.title: Computed at
computedAt.description: When the figures were read from the books.

reportingRole.title: Reporting role
reportingRole.description: The role of the reporting entity in the country-by-country file.

correctsReturn.title: Corrects return
correctsReturn.description: The submitted CbcrReturn this return corrects, empty for a first file.

docRefIds.title: Document references
docRefIds.description: The DocRefId given to each record in the last file, keyed by record id, so a correction can point at it.

lastValidation.title: Last validation
lastValidation.description: The outcome of the last file validation: valid, when, and the errors by line, element and message.

docRefIds.title: Document references
docRefIds.description: The DocRefId given to each record in the last file, keyed by record id.

lastValidation.title: Last validation
lastValidation.description: The outcome of the last file validation: valid, when, and the errors by line, element and message.

missingElements.title: Missing elements
missingElements.description: Mandatory elements of the GloBE information return the records cannot fill, per jurisdiction. The file is not made while this list is not empty.

element.title: Element
element.description: The element the records cannot fill.

cbcrCategory.title: Country-by-country category
cbcrCategory.description: Which country-by-country figure the account feeds. Suggested from the account type on first use and confirmed on the account mapping tab.
